metadata.question: Are there active fires in October 24, 2023 in Canada?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about active fires in Canada on October 24, 2023. For this, I should use fire detection data. The best options would be: 1. MODIS Active Fires (MODIS/006/MCD14ML) - daily fire data 2. VIIRS Active Fires (NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGML1) - higher resolution I'll use VIIRS as it's more sensitive to smaller fires. The approach: 1. Define Canada boundary using a feature collection 2. Filter VIIRS collection for the specific date 3. Check if collection is empty (C1) 4. Count fire pixels to determine if there are active fires 5. Validate the count is valid (not null/NaN) For fire detection, I'll use the 'FireMask' band and look for pixels with values indicating fires (typically values 7, 8, 9 for high confidence fires). Let me structure the code accordingly. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions var canada = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Canada')); var startDate = '2023-10-24'; var endDate = '2023-10-25'; // 2. Data Acquisition - VIIRS Active Fires var fires = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGML1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(canada); var fireCount = fires.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Fire detection images: ${fireCount}`); if (fireCount === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Count fire pixels var fireImage = fires.first(); // FireMask values: 7,8,9 = high confidence fires var firePixels = fireImage.select('FireMask') .gt(6); // Values 7,8,9 are high confidence fires var stats = firePixels.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: canada, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); var fireCount = stats.get('FireMask').getInfo(); console.log(`Active fire pixels: ${fireCount}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (fireCount === null || fireCount === undefined || isNaN(fireCount)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (fireCount > 0) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
